summary: Frontend changes clearly remove the admin-signup-password UI field and related error messaging. Backend changes are truncated; while a migration stub suggests removal of an `adminSignupPassword` field, the diff summary does not provide sufficient evidence that the backend no longer enforces an "incorrect signup password" gate in admin signup logic.
